input.question: What sport is Nicholas Hill associated with?

documents.text: Hill competed with Caleb Hanie for the Bears ' third quarterback spot on the depth chart behind Kyle Orton and Rex Grossman . The Bears chose to keep Hanie as their practice squad quarterback and Hill was waived by the Bears on July 29 . After not playing in the National Football League in 2008 , Hill joined af2 , a professional arena football league . On January 15 , 2009 , he was assigned to the Rio Grande Valley Dorados . [ 2 ] [ 3 ] Hill caught on with the Orlando Predators for the 2010 AFL season
